The first term is $13$ and the common difference is $-7$.

| $\footnotesize\maroonC{-7\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{-7\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{-7\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | |
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$13,$ | | $6,$ | | $-1,$ | | $-8,...$

This is the recursive formula of $13, 6, -1, -8,...$

$\begin{cases}
c(1)=13
\\\\
c(n)=c(n-1)+(-7)
\end{cases}$
